title: Extract a shared pump helper in learning_screen_l1_test.dart instead of 4 inline MaterialApp/localizationsDelegates blocks

evidence.quote:
ProviderScope(
          retry: (_, __) => null, // disable retry so error state persists

why: The R6-4 AsyncLoading test, the R6-4 AsyncError test, and the E4 regression test each re-declare their own ProviderScope + MaterialApp + the full 4-delegate localizationsDelegates list inline instead of extending _buildScreen (which already exists in the same file) with a streakStream/router parameter. Any future change to the delegates list or supportedLocales must be replicated across 4 places in this one file; the pattern in test/e2e/harness/e2e_harness.dart (pumpApp(...)) shows the repo already knows how to centralize this, it just isn't used at the widget-test tier.
recommendation: Add optional streakStream and router parameters to _buildScreen and route all 4 call sites through it, or adopt a shared test/helpers/pump_app.dart per TQ-3's stated convention.
acceptance_criteria: localizationsDelegates/supportedLocales list appears exactly once in learning_screen_l1_test.dart
All testWidgets in the file that pump LearningScreen go through _buildScreen or a shared helper
